name: branded_identity_truth_v1
purpose: Human ground truth for whether a candidate product IS the food the user named. Labelled from product knowledge BEFORE any confidence was computed, so the distribution cannot shape the truth.

labels.TRUE_SAME_PRODUCT: the candidate is the product the user meant; its nutrition may price the meal
labels.TRUE_DIFFERENT_PRODUCT: a different SKU. Accepting it commits another food's numbers
labels.AMBIGUOUS: a human cannot decide from the strings alone. NEITHER accepting nor rejecting is an error, so these are excluded from precision/recall and reported separately

why_the_hard_cases: Easy pairs measure nothing. A threshold is only calibratable against neighbours that are genuinely close: same brand, same family, different SKU. Every DIFFERENT case below is a near neighbour, not junk.
